title: Planning London Datahub public guest API
licence: Open Government Licence likely for GLA public data; confirm per PLD terms before redistribution
spatial_granularity: planning application / development proposal; point/geometry where supplied
temporal_granularity: live/near-real-time updates from London planning authorities
